Currently allowed origins: `http://localhost:4200`, any `*.pages.dev`, and any `*.workers.dev` subdomain.

**Where it's defined:** `worker/src/index.ts`, in the `cors({ origin: (origin) => {...} })` function (lines ~20-31) — Hono's CORS middleware requires a function here because its string-array matching is exact-only, not wildcard-aware.

**To add a new custom domain:** add another condition inside that same `origin` function in `worker/src/index.ts`, e.g.:
```ts
if (
  origin === 'http://localhost:4200' ||
  origin === 'https://your-custom-domain.com' ||   // add here
  origin.endsWith('.pages.dev') ||
  origin.endsWith('.workers.dev')
) { return origin; }
```
Also update the matching note in `docs/DEPLOYMENT_NOTES.md` §4 (CORS) and `worker/src/index.md`, which document this same logic.
